data.name: SATURN. LEGACY
data.detailed_description:
Who do you see in your reflection?

Saturn: Legacy is a first-person sci-fi RPG where you explore a futuristic underground complex and control robots on missions across the moons of Saturn.

The year is 2065.
You are Alexey Vengerov, an operator of the experimental neuro-interface “Reflection” - a system capable of transferring human consciousness into machine bodies.

During your internship at a classified research facility in the Ural Mountains, a catastrophic failure occurs: robots go rogue, and Alexey is accused of sabotage.

To clear your name and uncover the truth, you must fight your way through laboratories consumed by a machine uprising, restore communication with the outside world, and reconnect to the Reflection system.

Only then will you discover the truth - and it awaits you in the orbit of Saturn.

FEATURES

Roleplaying & Choice

Define who your character becomes.

Approach situations with strength, intelligence, or cunning - your decisions affect dialogue options, access to locations, and the course of the story.

Before the game begins, choose your character’s background and hobbies. These shape how others perceive you, unlock unique dialogue choices, and open unique questlines.

Combat & Tactics

Combat is not just about reflexes - it’s about strategy.

Control your distance, use abilities wisely, and exploit enemy weaknesses by destroying their armor.

Sometimes the best path is straight through. Sometimes it’s smarter to avoid combat entirely - especially when facing enemies you cannot defeat.

Two Worlds

Connect to the Reflection system and take control of robots on Saturn’s moons to find a way to survive on Earth.

Survive the Earth Facility

You are human surrounded by hostile machines.

Move carefully. Choose your encounters wisely. Some enemies are simply too powerful. Stay quiet, explore ruined laboratories with caution, and fight to reach the surface.

Explore Saturn’s Orbital Stations

Your consciousness is now inside a robot.

Take risks. Experiment freely. Here, you stand on equal footing with other machines - and your greatest weapon is your mind. If you fail, reconnect through Reflection, build a new robotic body, and try again with a different strategy.

Neuro-Interface “Reflection”

Transfer your consciousness into robotic bodies and control them directly - both on Earth and in space.

Each robot has unique abilities and characteristics. Customize them to match your playstyle.

Every choice you make - in combat, in dialogue, or in the bodies you inhabit - shapes not only your path to the truth, but who Alexey Vengerov ultimately becomes.

So… who will you see in your reflection?

data.short_description: Saturn: Legacy is a first-person sci-fi RPG. Embark on a gripping journey: uncover the secrets of a hidden research facility on Earth, fight in robotic bodies across Saturn’s moons, shape the story through your choices, and reclaim the identity that was taken from you.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
